slides.texte_overlay:
strange habits of people
everyone wants to be around

they celebrate small wins

they get genuinely excited about your small news, a new plant, a good grade, a finished run. being celebrated for little things is rare, and people never forget it.

they ask for advice

they ask people for advice on things they're good at. it makes others feel valued and capable, and people grow fond of anyone who makes them feel that way.

they share the last bite

they always offer the last bite, the better seat, the umbrella. small generous gestures make people feel safe around you without a single word being said.

they bring a new idea

they show up with one new idea or fact each day from 5 minutes of learning: a planet, a painter, a moment in history. people lean in when someone always brings something new.

they keep secrets

they never repeat what someone told them in confidence, not even as a joke. trust builds slowly and breaks fast, and people quietly gather around those who keep it.
